Crunchbase shows funding of about 445 million dollars, a very large amount for a young company, so it is likely a recently launched, heavily capitalised venture. Customers are enterprises, and it is B2B with essentially no consumer awareness. Details of its founders and customers should be checked.

about: ASAPP is a New York software company selling AI-powered customer experience technology for contact centres, with agentic AI platform products like GenerativeAgent and AI Summary used by large US consumer companies in telecoms, travel and financial services. Founded in 2014, it has raised about 400 million dollars from Emergence, Dragoneer and others and has a valuation of 1.6 billion dollars. B2B with limited public awareness.

Capacity is a Saint Louis-based AI platform that automates support and business workflows with chatbots and knowledge tools, serving customers in HR, IT, legal and finance functions. Crunchbase shows funding of about 443 million dollars. It is a B2B software company with limited consumer awareness, known mostly among enterprise software buyers.

Datavault AI is a US technology company, formerly WiSA Technologies, based in Beaverton, Oregon, developing spatial audio wireless technology and then AI data monetisation and credentialing platforms with focus on sports, entertainment and tokenised assets. Listed on Nasdaq (DVLT), it has frequently changed its focus and has had significant losses. Funding shown is about 392 million dollars. Low consumer awareness, though it has announced sports-related partnerships and licensing.

about: Dexterity is a Redwood City robotics company developing AI-powered robots, such as truck-loading robots and the Mech system, for logistics and parcel handling, with customers like FedEx, UPS and Maersk. Founded in 2017, it has raised funding of about 396 million dollars, with a valuation of 1.65 billion dollars after a 2025 round. B2B with no consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: Fine motor skill
wiki.what: Coordination of small muscles, particularly of the hands and fingers, with the eyes
wiki.text: Fine motor skill or dexterity is the coordination of small muscles in movement with the eyes, hands and fingers. The complex levels of manual dexterity that humans exhibit can be related to the nervous system. Fine motor skills aid in the growth of intelligence and develop continuously throughout the stages of human development.

about: Factory is a San Francisco AI start-up building autonomous software development agents called Droids, which write, test and fix code inside engineering teams' existing tools, sold to enterprises. Founded in 2023, it has raised funding of about 420 million dollars, including a 2026 round at a multi-billion valuation backed by investors such as Sequoia, Khosla Ventures and NEA. Revenue is subscription and usage based. B2B developer software with strong standing in the tech community and little general consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Factory
wiki.what: Facility where goods are industrially made, or processed
wiki.text: A factory, manufacturing plant or production plant is an industrial facility, often a complex consisting of several buildings filled with machinery, where workers manufacture items or operate machines which process each item into another. They are a critical part of modern economic production, with the majority of the world's goods being created or processed within factories.

about: Field AI develops autonomy software, the Field Foundation Models, that lets robots such as legged machines and vehicles navigate complex off-road, industrial and construction environments without maps. It is based in Irvine, California, and was founded in 2023. In 2025 it raised about 400 million dollars at a valuation near 2 billion dollars from investors including Bezos Expeditions and Prysm. Customers include construction, energy, mining and defence operators. B2B robotics software with limited consumer awareness.

Funding shown is about 441 million dollars. Customers are governments and large enterprises; B2B, with little consumer brand awareness. Details of ownership and projects should be verified.

about: Horizon3.ai is a San Francisco cybersecurity company whose NodeZero platform runs autonomous penetration tests, finding and exploiting weaknesses in customers' networks. Customers include enterprises, government agencies and managed security providers. Founded in 2019 by former US special operations cyber specialist Snehal Antani, it has raised funding of about 430 million dollars, including 100 million in 2025. B2B security software with little general consumer awareness.

Keel Infrastructure is a New York company that develops and owns data centre campuses for AI workloads, with a focus on securing power and land for large-scale compute. Funding shown is about 400 million dollars. Customers are cloud, hyperscaler and AI companies leasing capacity. B2B infrastructure with no consumer brand awareness. Details should be verified given its recent origin.

about: Otter.ai is a Mountain View company whose AI meeting assistant (OtterPilot) joins calls, transcribes them in real time, and generates summaries and action items, integrating with Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams. Founded in 2016, it has over 25 million users and annual recurring revenue above 100 million dollars. Funding of about 393 million dollars. Subscriptions sold to individuals and enterprises. Fairly well known among knowledge workers.

wiki.title: Otter.ai
wiki.text: Otter.ai, Inc. is an American transcription software company based in Mountain View, California. The company develops speech to text transcription applications using artificial intelligence and machine learning. Its software, called Otter, shows captions for live speakers, and generates written transcriptions of speech.

about: Scale Computing is an Austin-based provider of edge computing and hyperconverged infrastructure, with its HyperCore software and SC//Platform for retailers, manufacturers, schools and government sites that need simple on-site IT. Customers include thousands of small and mid-sized organisations plus resellers. Founded in 2007, it has raised funding of about 437 million dollars. B2B with limited consumer awareness.

Vena Solutions is a Toronto software company offering a cloud platform for corporate finance, covering budgeting, planning, forecasting and consolidation, built around Microsoft Excel. Customers include mid-sized and large enterprises in sectors like manufacturing, healthcare and finance. Founded in 2002, it has raised funding of about 418 million dollars, mostly from Battery Ventures and Summit Partners. B2B with limited consumer awareness.

Aptean is an Alpharetta, Georgia enterprise software company selling industry-specific ERP, supply chain and finance software to manufacturers, distributors and process industries such as food and beverage, with thousands of customers worldwide. It is private equity owned and has grown through many acquisitions. Funding of about 2.2 billion dollars is shown. B2B software with no consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: Aptean
wiki.text: Aptean is an American software company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. It develops enterprise software that supports core operational functions such as manufacturing, distribution, supply chain management, and product lifecycle management (PLM). The company’s products are used by mid-sized and enterprise organisations operating in industries including food and beverage, fresh produce, fashion and apparel, transportation, retail, logistics, financial services, and both process manufacturing and discrete manufacturing.

about: Polkadot is a blockchain protocol and network (token DOT) created by Gavin Wood, a co-founder of Ethereum, and developed by Parity Technologies and the Web3 Foundation, which is based in Zug, Switzerland. It links many specialised blockchains (parachains) so they can share security and exchange data. Revenue comes from token issuance and treasury rather than product sales; funding includes a 2017 token sale and later raises of about $300 million. Known mainly within crypto and developer circles, with limited general consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Polka dot
wiki.what: Pattern consisting of an array of large filled circles of same size
wiki.text: The polka dot, also written polkadot, and also called spot printed and spot print in the United Kingdom and pois ("peas") in France, is a pattern consisting of an array of large filled circles of the same size. Though the dots must be relatively large ones, and must be all the same size in any given print, different styles of polka dot prints may change the size of the dots or the distance between them.

about: CoinDCX is an Indian cryptocurrency exchange headquartered in Mumbai, founded in 2018. It offers an app and website for retail users to buy, sell and trade crypto, plus products such as futures and staking, and earns trading fees. It became India's first crypto unicorn in 2021 with backing from Coinbase Ventures and others, and has raised roughly $247 million in total. It has millions of registered users, runs heavy advertising in India, and has sponsored cricket-related campaigns. Strong consumer brand awareness in India.

RedotPay is a Hong Kong-based stablecoin payments fintech founded in 2023 that offers a wallet and card letting users hold and spend crypto and stablecoins such as USDT at merchants worldwide, as well as remittances and business payments. Revenue comes from card, transfer and conversion fees. It has raised about $194 million, with backers including Pantera and Goodwater. Users are mainly in Asia, Africa and Latin America. Growing crypto-consumer brand, limited mainstream awareness.

about: Bitwise is a San Francisco-based crypto asset manager, founded in 2017, which offers index funds and exchange-traded products, including the Bitwise 10 Crypto Index fund, Bitcoin ETF (BITB) and Ethereum ETF. It sells to individuals, advisers and institutions and earns management fees on tens of billions of dollars of assets. It has raised about $155 million in venture funding and was an early mover in spot bitcoin ETFs in the US. Strong in the investor community, with modest mass-market awareness.

wiki.title: Bitwise operation
wiki.what: Computer operation which manipulates individual bits of data
wiki.text: In computer programming, a bitwise operation operates on a bit string, a bit array or a binary numeral at the level of its individual bits. It is a fast and simple action, basic to the higher-level arithmetic operations and directly supported by the processor. Most architectures provide only a few high value bitwise operations, presented as two-operand instructions where the result replaces one of the input operands.

about: Inflection AI is a Palo Alto AI company, founded in 2022 by Mustafa Suleyman, Reid Hoffman and Karen Simonyan, which built the Pi personal AI chatbot and raised about $1.5 billion from investors including Microsoft and Nvidia. In 2024 Microsoft hired Suleyman and much of the team, and Inflection licensed its models, now refocusing on enterprise AI. Limited current consumer visibility.

wiki.title: Inflection AI
wiki.text: Inflection AI, Inc. is an American technology company which has developed machine learning and generative artificial intelligence hardware and apps, founded in 2022. The company is structured as a public benefit corporation and is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.

about: Qualtrics is a Provo, Utah experience management software company, founded in 2002, whose platform lets enterprises run customer and employee surveys and analyse feedback. It was bought by SAP in 2018, floated on Nasdaq in 2021, then taken private by Silver Lake and CPP Investments in a $12.5 billion deal that closed in 2023. Customers are large companies, universities and governments. Strong B2B awareness, and it has run notable sports sponsorships in the past.

wiki.title: Qualtrics
wiki.text: Qualtrics, LLC is an American experience management company, with co-headquarters in Seattle, Washington, and Provo, Utah. The company was founded in 2002 by Scott M. Smith, Ryan Smith, Jared Smith, and Stuart Orgill.

about: Sinch is a Stockholm-based cloud communications company, listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (SINCH), that offers messaging (SMS, WhatsApp, RCS), voice and email APIs for businesses to contact their customers, serving thousands of enterprise customers worldwide. It grew through acquisitions including MessageBird-era rivals such as Mailgun, Pathwire and Inteliquent. Revenue is about 28 billion Swedish kronor. B2B with little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Sinch AB
wiki.what: Telecommunications and cloud communications platform as a service (PaaS) company
wiki.text: Sinch AB, formerly CLX Communications, is a communications platform as a service (CPaaS) company which powers messaging, voice, and email communications between businesses and their customers. Headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, the company employs over 4000 people in more than 60 countries.

about: Automation Anywhere is a San Jose, California software company, founded in 2003, that sells robotic process automation and AI-driven agent automation to large enterprises, including banks and insurers. It has raised about $1 billion, peaking at a $6.8 billion valuation in 2019, and trimmed staff in recent years. Customers pay software subscriptions. Known among enterprise IT buyers, with little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Automation Anywhere
wiki.text: Automation Anywhere is an American global software company that develops robotic process automation (RPA) and agentic process automation software.

about: Tradeshift is a San Francisco-based software company, founded in 2010, that offered a cloud platform for supply chain payments, invoicing and B2B commerce, used by large corporates and their suppliers. It raised more than a billion dollars, with a peak valuation of about $1.1 billion, and was later reported to be restructuring and under new ownership; current status should be checked. Customers are enterprises. B2B with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Tradeshift
wiki.what: Global cloud based business platform and network
wiki.text: Tradeshift is a cloud based business network and platform for purchase-to-pay automation, supply chain payments, marketplaces, virtual cards and supply chain financing. Its 2018 round of funding, led by Goldman Sachs, raised US$250 million at a valuation of $1.1 billion, giving the company unicorn status. Tradeshift is headquartered in San Francisco, California and has offices in London, Copenhagen, Bucharest and Kuala Lumpur. Tradeshift has reprocessed over $1 trillion USD through transactions on its network.

about: Axonius is a New York cybersecurity software company, founded in 2017 in Israel, which sells cybersecurity asset management, giving enterprises a single view of all devices, users and cloud resources to find gaps. It has raised about $865 million and was valued at about $2.6 billion. Customers are large enterprises and governments. B2B with strong profile among security teams but little consumer awareness.

Alarm.com is a Tysons, Virginia company, listed on Nasdaq (ALRM), which provides cloud-based software and platform for connected home and business security, video, energy and access control, sold through thousands of security dealers. Revenue is about $940 million. Consumers access it via the Alarm.com app on dealer-installed systems. Sold through service providers, so the brand is B2B2C with moderate awareness.

wiki.title: Alarm.com
wiki.text: Alarm.com, Inc. is an American technology company that provides cloud-based services for remote control, home automation, and alarm monitoring services. The company was founded in 2000 as a spinoff from MicroStrategy. The company is based in Tysons, Virginia.

about: Astek Group is a French engineering and IT consulting group headquartered in Boulogne-Billancourt, supplying engineering, digital and technology services to aerospace, automotive, energy and banking clients. It is listed on Euronext Paris and employs around 8,000 staff, with revenue of about 700 million euros. B2B with low public brand awareness. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Verbit is a New York-based AI transcription and captioning company, founded in 2014, which combines AI and human editors to provide captions, transcripts and audio description for education, media, courts and corporate clients. It acquired VITAC and Automatic Sync. Funding is about $569 million, with a valuation near $2 billion. B2B with limited consumer awareness.

Magic is a San Francisco AI coding startup, founded in 2022, building models with very long context windows to help software engineers write and review code. Investors include Eric Schmidt, Google and Nat Friedman, with funding of about $466 million. Customers are developers and companies. B2B with a modest public profile.

Mercor is a San Francisco AI recruiting and expert-data platform, founded in 2023, that matches experts with AI labs for training and evaluation work and offers hiring tools. It was valued at about $10 billion in a 2025 round, and funding shown is about $484 million. Customers include leading AI labs. B2B with rapidly rising profile in tech.

wiki.title: Mercor
wiki.text: Mercor.io Corporation (Mercor) is an American artificial intelligence (AI) data startup that provides experts to train AI models and chatbots. Founded in 2023, the company is headquartered in 181 Fremont, San Francisco.

about: Pegasystems is a Waltham, Massachusetts software company, listed on Nasdaq (PEGA), that sells low-code workflow, case management and customer decisioning software to banks, insurers, governments and healthcare. Revenue is about $1.5 billion. Its Pega Infinity platform is built around AI-led process automation. B2B with strong profile among large enterprises, and Pega has been a visible sponsor in sport.

wiki.title: Pegasystems
wiki.text: Pegasystems Inc. (Pega) is a global AI software company based in Waltham, Massachusetts, in the United States. The company has been publicly traded since 1996 as PEGA (NASDAQ). Pega is a low-code platform for workflow automation, business process management, and generative AI-powered decision-making for businesses.

about: Synthesia is a London-based AI video platform, founded in 2017, that lets businesses generate videos with AI avatars and voices from text, used for training, marketing and communications. It has raised about $537 million and was valued at $4 billion in January 2026. Customers include many Fortune 100 companies. B2B with fast-rising profile in AI.

wiki.title: Synthesia (company)
wiki.text: Synthesia Limited is a British multinational artificial intelligence company based in London, United Kingdom. It is a synthetic media-generation software developer and creator of AI-generated video content, including audio-visual agents and cloned avatars. Britain's largest generative-AI firm, it is used by 70% of FTSE 100 and over 90% of Fortune 100 companies.

about: Unconventional AI is a San Diego-area AI hardware startup, according to Crunchbase, which describes rethinking the foundations of computing for AI. Founded in 2025 by Naveen Rao, a former Databricks AI head, it reportedly raised a very large seed round. Recorded funding is about $475 million. B2B, deep technology, with a growing profile in AI hardware. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Customers include large enterprises such as Atlassian and Intuit, mostly on subscription. Has raised about USD 415 million and was valued at roughly USD 5.7 billion. B2B software with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.text: Workato is an American multinational software company that provides a cloud-based platform for automation, integration, and artificial intelligence (AI) orchestration across applications, data, and systems. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.

Backed by large Korean investors. Consumer app with solid awareness among Korean users; little presence outside Korea.

Owned by Monex Group of Japan. Serves Japanese retail users trading bitcoin and other tokens. Consumer brand with high awareness in Japan.

Helsinki AI cloud provider, formerly DataCrunch, renting GPU capacity and AI infrastructure to developers and enterprises from data centres in Finland. Backed by European investors. DataCrunch, founded in 2019, sells dedicated GPU clusters and serverless inference powered by renewable electricity, mainly with Nvidia chips. B2B with limited public brand awareness.

London AI compliance and surveillance firm that helps banks monitor communications and detect misconduct. Founded in 2014 and backed by SoftBank and General Atlantic. It was founded by Erkin Adylov and sells its AI compliance products to global investment banks and regulators' regulated firms. B2B software with limited public awareness.

Bengaluru-based trucking platform offering a freight marketplace, fuel cards and payments for truck operators. Raised funding from Tiger Global and Accel and listed on Indian exchanges in 2025. The company is formally Zinka Logistics Solutions, founded in 2015 by Rajesh Yabaji, Chanakya Hridaya and Ramasubramanian B, and listed in India in November 2025. B2B with strong awareness among truckers.

wiki.title: Blackbuck
wiki.what: Antelope native to India and Nepal
wiki.text: The blackbuck is a medium-sized antelope native to India and Nepal. It inhabits grassy plains and lightly forested areas with perennial water sources.

about: Tokyo-based manufacturing procurement and AI data platform helping companies source made-to-order parts and drawings. Founded in 2017 and backed by Japanese and global investors. Founder Yushiro Kato, a former McKinsey consultant, set it up in 2017 and its main product is CADDi Drawer, which organises engineering drawings with AI. B2B with low consumer awareness.

San Francisco data and AI marketing platform that syncs a company's data warehouse with marketing tools and runs AI marketing agents. Customers include large brands. Founders Tejas Manohar, Kashish Gupta and Josh Curl created the reverse ETL category and now sell a composable customer data platform. B2B software with strong standing among data teams.

US generative engine optimisation start-up that tracks how brands appear in AI answers from ChatGPT and other chatbots. Founded 2024 and backed by Sequoia and Kleiner Perkins. B2B with little consumer awareness.

Tokyo AI research lab founded in 2023 by former Google researchers, developing nature-inspired foundation models and the AI Scientist. Valued above USD 2 billion. Backed by Japanese banks and global investors. Co-founders David Ha and Llion Jones, an author of the Transformer paper, run the lab, and MUFG has partnered on financial AI. It focuses on evolutionary and nature-inspired methods. Research and B2B brand with growing visibility in Japan.

wiki.title: Sakana AI
wiki.text: Sakana AI Co, Ltd. is a Japanese artificial intelligence company based in Tokyo.

about: Indian AI company in Bengaluru building Indian-language large models and voice AI, selected under India's national AI mission. Founded in 2023. B2B and government customers, rising profile in India.

wiki.title: Sarvam AI
wiki.text: Sarvam AI is an Indian artificial intelligence company headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka. Founded in 2023, the company develops large language models (LLMs) such as Indus and multimodal AI systems with a focus on Indian languages and region-specific use cases.

about: French IT services and consulting group, formed by Sopra and Steria in 2014, with about 56,000 staff and revenue of around EUR 5.8 billion. Based in Paris area. Listed on Euronext Paris (SOP). Sopra Steria also includes Sopra Banking Software, and the Pasquier family remains a significant shareholder. It operates mostly in France, the UK, Germany and the Nordics. B2B digital services with sports sponsorship in rugby and cycling visibility.

wiki.title: Sopra Steria
wiki.text: Sopra Steria is a European-based consulting, digital services, and software development company with 50,000 consultants. The company is headquartered in Paris and has operations in several countries in Western Europe.

about: California edge AI chip and software company, listed on Nasdaq (BZAI) via a 2025 SPAC merger with BurTech, selling processors for vision AI in automotive, defence and retail. Blaize was formerly Thinci, founded in 2010, and its architecture is called the Graph Streaming Processor. It completed a SPAC deal with BurTech in January 2025. B2B with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Quantifind
wiki.text: Quantifind is an American technology company that provides software as a service to discover, investigate, and report entity risk as an indicator of potential financial risk, financial crime, and money laundering. The software is used by financial institutions and government agencies.

wiki.title: Simile
wiki.what: Figure of speech marked by explicit comparison
wiki.text: A simile is a type of figure of speech that directly compares two unrelated things, using wording to explicitly make the comparison. It is usually understood specifically to entail figurative comparison: thus "a wolf is like a dog" is merely a literal comparison, whereas the figurative "a man is like a wolf" is a simile. In the words of Michael Israel, Jennifer Riddle Harding, and Vera Tobin, "basically, a simile is just a way of describing a target by asserting its similarity to some unexpected entity".

about: US robotics start-up building wheeled, two-armed semi-humanoid robots to handle tasks in workplaces. Customers would be businesses automating manual work. Early-stage B2B technology company with no consumer brand; funding, ownership and customers are not confirmed here.

Backed by European investors. CEO Fabrizio Pirondini leads it, and L3Harris is building the satellite sensors. B2B space and data company with no consumer awareness; based in Madrid.

wiki.title: Augustus
wiki.what: Roman emperor from 27 BC to AD 14
wiki.text: Augustus, also known as Octavian, was the founder of the Roman Empire and the first Roman emperor from 27 BC until his death in AD 14. The reign of Augustus initiated an imperial cult and an era of imperial peace when the Roman world was largely free of armed conflict. The principate, a style of government in which the emperor showed nominal deference to the Senate, was established during his reign and lasted until the Crisis of the Third Century.

about: US artificial intelligence start-up building AI systems for mathematical reasoning and proofs, with applications in software verification. Customers would be researchers and companies. Early-stage research company with no consumer brand awareness; funding is not confirmed here.

wiki.title: Axiom
wiki.what: Statement that is taken to be true
wiki.text: An axiom, postulate, or assumption, is a statement that is taken to be true, to serve as a premise or starting point for further reasoning and arguments. The word comes from the Ancient Greek word ἀξίωμα (axíōma), meaning 'that which is thought worthy or fit' or 'that which commends itself as evident'.

about: Canadian automation platform company based in Montreal, offering a browser-based design tool and on-demand parts and software for building industrial automation and robot cells. Customers are manufacturers and integrators. Founder Etienne Lacroix started it in 2016 and its hardware is branded MachineMotion. B2B technology firm with growing awareness in engineering.

wiki.title: Vention
wiki.text: Vention is a global industrial automation company headquartered in Montreal, Canada. It supplies an AI-powered full-stack platform that combines engineering software, automation hardware, and physical AI to enable manufacturers to design, deploy, and operate turnkey or custom automation solutions.

about: US enterprise carbon accounting and climate platform based in San Francisco, used by large companies such as Walmart and Airbnb to measure emissions and set sustainability targets. Revenue comes from software subscriptions. Watershed was founded in 2019 by Taylor Francis and Christian Anderson, and a 2024 round valued it at USD 1.8 billion. B2B with no consumer awareness but a strong name among sustainability teams.

US autonomous security testing start-up whose AI agent has ranked at the top of bug bounty leaderboards. Customers are companies that want continuous penetration testing, paying software subscriptions. Founded in 2024 and backed by notable investors. Founder Oege de Moor previously created GitHub's code analysis tool Semmle. B2B with niche recognition in cybersecurity.

OneTrust is an Atlanta, Georgia software company, founded in 2016, offering a platform for privacy, data governance, AI governance, third-party risk and security compliance used by thousands of companies. Customers are enterprises, and revenue is from subscriptions. It raised significant venture funding, was valued at about $5.3 billion in 2021, and has a strong international presence. B2B brand, widely known among compliance and legal teams but not consumers.

wiki.title: OneTrust
wiki.text: OneTrust, LLC is an American software company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It develops governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) software with a focus on privacy, security, data protection, and AI governance. Its platform includes tools for consent management, data mapping, third-party risk assessments, and regulatory compliance automation. As of 2025, the company reports more than 14,000 customers worldwide and over 300 patents. The company occupies a 74,000-square-foot headquarters along the Atlanta Beltline and maintains regional offices in London, Bangalore, Madrid, Paris, Munich, Singapore and Melbourne.

about: Meltwater is a media intelligence and social listening software company, headquartered in San Francisco (founded in Norway in 2001), selling media monitoring, social analytics and PR tools to enterprises worldwide, with about 27,000 customers. Privately held; Crunchbase shows about $300 million in funding. B2B software, known in PR and marketing circles.

wiki.title: Meltwater
wiki.what: Water released by the melting of snow or ice
wiki.text: Meltwater is water released by the melting of snow or ice, including glacial ice, tabular icebergs and ice shelves over oceans. Meltwater is often found during early spring when snow packs and frozen rivers melt with rising temperatures, and in the ablation zone of glaciers where the rate of snow cover is reducing. Meltwater can be produced during volcanic eruptions, in a similar way in which the more dangerous lahars form. It can also be produced by the heat generated by the flow itself.

wiki.title: Meltwater (company)
wiki.text: Meltwater is an online media, social and consumer intelligence company. The company was founded in Oslo, Norway, by Jørn Lyseggen, in 2001 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California, with additional offices across Europe, North America, Asia/Pacific, Australia, and Africa. The company employs around 2,200 people and has approximately 27,000 clients internationally. In February 2023, Meltwater reported US$439 million in revenue for the full 2022 fiscal year.

about: StarkWare Industries is an Israeli blockchain company, based in Netanya, founded in 2018, developing STARK zero-knowledge proof technology for Ethereum scaling, with StarkEx and the Starknet layer-2 network. Customers include crypto exchanges and applications such as dYdX and Immutable. Crunchbase shows about $273 million in funding. B2B crypto infrastructure, well known in the crypto developer community.

wiki.title: StarkWare Industries
wiki.text: StarkWare Industries is an Israeli software company that specializes in cryptography. It develops zero-knowledge proof technology that compresses information to address the scalability problem of the blockchain, and works on the Ethereum platform. In May 2022, the company's estimated value was $8 billion, an increase from $2 billion six months earlier.

about: Nimble Robotics is a San Francisco AI robotics company building autonomous robots for e-commerce fulfillment, including its Nimble Pick robots and fulfillment systems, with customers among large retailers and logistics providers. Crunchbase shows about $221 million in funding. B2B, with limited public awareness outside logistics.

about: Elvie is a London femtech company, founded in 2013 by Tania Boler, known for the Elvie Pump, a quiet wearable breast pump, and the Elvie Trainer pelvic floor device, sold to mothers via retail and direct online. It has raised about $190 million from investors including Octopus and Kindred. Elvie entered administration in 2025 and its assets were sold to Chiaro. Consumer brand with strong awareness among new mothers in the UK and US.

Infor is a New York enterprise software company providing industry-specific ERP and cloud applications, including CloudSuite, for manufacturing, healthcare, distribution, hospitality and public sector customers in about 170 countries. Owned by Koch Industries since 2020 (acquired in 2020 from Golden Gate Capital). Revenue is about $3 billion. B2B software, with brand known to enterprise IT buyers and sports sponsorship history.

wiki.title: Infor
wiki.text: Infor is a multinational company headquartered in Atlanta that provides industry-specific, enterprise software, licensed for use on-premises or as a service.

about: Contentsquare is a Paris-based digital experience analytics company, founded in 2012, offering product, behaviour and conversion analytics that shows how people use websites and apps, with customers including major retailers and banks. It acquired Heap and Hotjar. Crunchbase shows about $1.4 billion in funding. Private B2B software brand, known by digital marketers.

project44 is a Chicago-based supply chain visibility platform, founded in 2014, which tracks shipments across road, rail, ocean and air for shippers, carriers and logistics providers, using real-time data networks. It raised about $940 million, at a valuation of over 2 billion dollars. Customers are large enterprises. B2B software with moderate visibility in logistics and sports sponsorship interest.

Securonix is a Plano, Texas cybersecurity analytics company that provides a cloud-native security information and event management platform, using behaviour analytics and AI to detect threats for large enterprises. Founded in 2008. Crunchbase shows about $1.06 billion in funding. B2B security software, known to security teams.

Attentive is a New York based SaaS company offering a personalized text-message and email marketing platform for retail and e-commerce brands. Its AI-driven tools help brands send SMS campaigns, abandoned-cart reminders and product recommendations to shoppers. Customers are thousands of consumer brands, and revenue comes from software subscriptions tied to message volume. Founded in 2016, it has raised roughly $860 million in venture funding and was valued at over $10 billion in 2021. It is B2B with little consumer brand awareness, though its fashion and retail clients are widely known.

wiki.title: Attention
wiki.what: Psychological focus, perception and prioritising discrete information
wiki.text: Attention is the concentration of awareness directed at some task or phenomenon while mostly excluding others.

wiki.title: Attentive (company)
wiki.text: Attentive is an American company that sells a mobile marketing software service. Their customer engagement software is used by more than 8,000 businesses for multichannel marketing and interacting with customers through email, SMS, push notifications, and RCS. The company is based in New York City, with offices in San Francisco, CA; London, England; and Sydney, AUS.

about: Fivetran, based in Oakland, California, sells automated data integration software that moves data from business applications and databases into cloud warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery and Databricks. Customers are enterprises and data teams, and revenue is usage-based subscriptions. It was founded in 2012, was valued at 5.6 billion dollars in 2021, and has raised about $850 million in funding. It merged with dbt Labs in 2025. It is B2B and well known in data engineering but not among consumers.

Nxera is a Singapore based data centre operator, offering digitalisation, cloud and colocation services, according to Crunchbase, with recorded funding of about $800 million. It is understood to be the data centre arm of Singtel, branded Nxera in 2024 with sites across Asia Pacific. Customers are enterprises, hyperscalers and AI workloads. It is a B2B infrastructure brand with limited consumer visibility, though backed by a large telecom parent.
cb_desc: Nxera is a data centre operator that offers digitalization, clou.

about: Advance Intelligence Group is a Singapore based fintech and technology company operating several businesses across Southeast Asia, including Atome, a buy-now-pay-later app, plus AI-driven risk, data and enterprise services. Founded in 2016, it was valued at about 2 billion dollars after a 2021 round and has raised roughly $616 million. Atome serves millions of consumers through merchants in Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines and elsewhere. It is a recognizable consumer payments brand in the region, with some sponsorship activity.

Coupa Software is a Foster City, California provider of cloud-based business spend management software covering procurement, invoicing, expenses, supply chain and treasury. It had thousands of enterprise customers and was acquired by private equity firm Thoma Bravo in early 2023 for about 8 billion dollars, after being listed on Nasdaq (COUP) since 2016. It was founded in 2006. It is a B2B software brand known to finance and procurement teams, not to consumers, though it has sponsored events and sports.

wiki.title: Coupa
wiki.text: Coupa Software Incorporated is an American technology platform for AI-driven total spend management and supply chain. The company is headquartered in Foster City, California with offices throughout Europe, Latin America, and Asia Pacific. Coupa helps companies gain visibility into and control over how they spend money, optimize supply chains, and manage cash.

about: Northern Data Group is a Frankfurt based provider of high-performance computing infrastructure for AI, offering GPU cloud services (Taiga Cloud), Ardent data centers and Peak Mining crypto operations. Customers are AI developers and enterprises. It was listed on the Frankfurt exchange (NB2) and was set to be acquired by Rumble in a 2025 deal. Funding shown is around 575 million euros. It is a B2B infrastructure operator with limited consumer brand awareness.
cb_desc: Northern Data builds and offers global infrastructure solutions...

about: Squarespace is a New York based website building and hosting platform, offering templates, domains, e-commerce, scheduling and email marketing tools for individuals, creators and small businesses. It listed on the NYSE (SQSP) in 2021 and was taken private by Permira in 2024 in a deal valued at about 6.9 billion dollars. It has millions of subscribers and was founded in 2003 by Anthony Casalena. It is a well known consumer brand with heavy advertising, including Super Bowl spots, and has sponsored sports.

wiki.title: Squarespace
wiki.text: Squarespace, Inc. is an American website building, hosting, and domain registration company based in New York City. It provides software as a service for website building, e-commerce, domain registration, marketing, and online scheduling. The platform allows users to use pre-built website templates, drag-and-drop editing, and artificial intelligence-powered design tools.

about: Tonal is a San Francisco based maker of a wall-mounted smart home gym that uses electromagnetic resistance and AI to coach strength training, sold with a monthly membership of workout programmes. It sells direct to consumers through its website and retail partners, and has raised around $580 million, valuing it at 1.6 billion dollars in 2021. Founded in 2015, it has had a large consumer advertising presence and athlete partnerships including athletes in the NBA and NFL.

Abnormal AI (Abnormal Security) is a cybersecurity company, headquartered in San Francisco and listed here in Las Vegas, which sells cloud-native email and collaboration security that uses behavioral AI to block phishing, business email compromise and account takeover. Customers are large enterprises, including a significant share of the Fortune 500, paying subscriptions. Founded in 2018, it was valued around 5 billion dollars in 2024 and has raised roughly $534 million. It is a B2B brand with limited consumer awareness.

CData Software is a Chapel Hill, North Carolina software company providing data connectivity and integration tools, with drivers, connectors and cloud services that link applications and databases. Customers are enterprises, software vendors and developers who embed its connectors. Founded in 2014, it received a major investment from Warburg Pincus in 2024-2025 and has raised funding of around $510 million. It is a B2B software brand with little consumer awareness.
cb_desc: CData Software is a software company that offers data...

about: Higgsfield is an AI start-up for generative video tools, offering creators AI image-to-video and cinematic camera controls for social media content, with products used by marketers and creators. The Crunchbase entry shows funding of about $538 million, though its location is not given and the text is unclear. This seems to be a very recent company, with a growing profile among creators. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)
cb_desc: hge+Mor

about: I-TRACING is a Courbevoie, France cybersecurity services company offering audit, consulting, managed security services and identity protection to large organisations in Europe and beyond. It is part of the Ardian-backed cyber platform following a 2020s ownership change and has hundreds of staff. Funding recorded is about 500 million euros. It is a B2B specialist with strong recognition among IT security buyers in France but no consumer visibility.
cb_desc: I-TRACING is an IT company that provides data protection...

about: Semperis is a Hoboken, New Jersey cybersecurity company focusing on identity-system protection, offering software to defend, detect and recover Microsoft Active Directory and Entra ID from attacks. Founded in 2014 with strong roots in Israel, it counts large enterprises and governments as customers. It has raised around $500 million, with a valuation near 1 billion dollars in 2022, and in 2024 had a round led by Dell Technologies Capital and others. It is B2B with little consumer awareness.

Spring Health is a New York based mental health company providing employers with an evidence-based mental health benefit that includes therapy, medication management, coaching and AI-driven care navigation. Customers are large employers and health plans covering millions of members. Founded in 2016, it was valued at 3.3 billion dollars in 2024 and has raised about $466 million. It is a B2B health benefits brand known to HR leaders and increasingly through advertising.

wiki.title: Spring Health
wiki.text: Spring Health is an American digital mental health company that provides employee assistance programs and mental health benefits for employers and health plans. Founded in 2016 and based in New York City, Spring Health uses app-based cognitive exercises, coaching, therapy, and psychiatry, tailored by machine-learning algorithms. The company has become one of the highest-valued mental health startups, reaching a unicorn status with a $3.3 billion valuation by 2024.

about: YipitData is a New York based alternative data and research firm that collects data from web, transaction and other sources to provide analytics on companies and sectors, sold as subscriptions to hedge funds, asset managers and corporates. Founded in 2008, it counts many large investment funds as clients and has raised a major investment from Carlyle in 2021, with funding around $492 million. It is a B2B brand with little public awareness.

Seismic is a San Diego, California sales and marketing enablement software company, providing an AI-powered platform that helps sales teams find, personalize and present content and track engagement. Customers are large enterprises, especially in financial services, and the platform is sold on subscription. Founded in 2010, it was valued at 1.6 billion dollars in 2021 and has raised about $446 million. It is a B2B brand known in sales tech.

wiki.title: Seismology
wiki.what: Scientific study of earthquakes and propagation of elastic waves through a planet
wiki.text: Seismology is the scientific study of earthquakes and the generation and propagation of elastic waves through planetary bodies. It also includes studies of the environmental effects of earthquakes such as tsunamis; other seismic sources such as volcanoes, plate tectonics, glaciers, rivers, oceanic microseisms, and the atmosphere; and artificial processes such as explosions.

about: TradingView is a charting and social network platform for traders and investors, offering web and mobile charts, screeners, market data, scripting tools (Pine Script) and a community for sharing trade ideas. It earns revenue from paid subscription tiers and data and advertising, with tens of millions of monthly users worldwide. Founded in 2011, it has main operations in London and New York, and Crunchbase shows funding of about $389 million. It is a well known retail trading brand with an active sponsorship and advertising presence.

wiki.title: TradingView
wiki.what: Analysis platform for traders and investors
wiki.text: TradingView is an American-British social media network, social trading network, financial analysis platform and mobile app for traders and investors. The company was founded in 2011 and has offices in New York, Málaga, Tbilisi and London. As of 2020, the company ranks in the top 130 websites globally according to Alexa.

about: Varonis is a data security software company, with US headquarters listed here in Miami (earlier New York), that helps organisations discover, classify, monitor and protect sensitive data in cloud and on-premises systems, with an automated data security platform. Customers are enterprises and public bodies, mostly through subscriptions. Founded in 2005 in Israel, it is listed on Nasdaq (VRNS). It is a B2B cybersecurity brand with low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Varonis Systems
wiki.what: Software company based in New York City
wiki.text: Varonis Systems, Inc. is a software company based in Miami, Florida. The company’s Data Security Platform analyzes data, identities, and activity to find and remediate data exposure in cloud and multi-cloud environments, and in software-as-a-service (SaaS) and infrastructure-as-a-service (IaaS) applications that include AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Salesforce, ServiceNow, and databases.

about: A10 Networks is a San Jose, California networking and security company that sells application delivery controllers, load balancers, DDoS protection and carrier-grade networking products to service providers, cloud operators and enterprises. Founded in 2004, it is listed on the NYSE (ATEN) with revenue of roughly 250 million dollars a year. Customers are large telecom operators and data centers worldwide. It is a B2B hardware and software vendor with no consumer visibility.

wiki.title: A10 Networks
wiki.text: A10 Networks, Inc. is an American public company specializing in the manufacturing of application delivery controllers. Founded in 2004 by Lee Chen, co-founder of Foundry Networks, A10 originally serviced just the identity management market with its line of ID Series products. In early 2007, they added bandwidth management appliances. The company had its initial public offering on March 21, 2014, raising $187.5 million.

about: Astronomer is a New York based data orchestration company commercialising Apache Airflow, with its Astro platform that lets data teams build, run and monitor data pipelines. Customers are enterprises in many industries. Founded in 2018, it raised a $93 million Series D in 2025 and has total funding of about $378 million per the record. It is a B2B data engineering brand, and drew wide public attention in 2025 following a viral kiss-cam event at a Coldplay concert involving its CEO.

wiki.title: Astronomer
wiki.what: Scientist in the field of astronomy
wiki.text: An astronomer is a scientist in the field of astronomy who focuses on a specific question or field outside the scope of Earth. Astronomers study astronomical objects, such as stars, planets, moons, comets and galaxies, by some combination of observation and the application of astrophysical models. Examples of topics or fields astronomers study include planetary science, solar astronomy, the origin or evolution of stars, or the formation of galaxies. A related but distinct subject is physical cosmology, which studies the universe as a whole.

about: EvenUp is a San Francisco legal technology company using AI to prepare personal injury demand packages and case documents for plaintiffs' law firms, speeding up claims and settlements. Customers are US personal injury law firms, on a subscription or service basis. Founded in 2019, it became a unicorn in 2024 with a valuation above 2 billion dollars, with funding of about $370 million reported. It is a B2B legal tech brand with little consumer awareness.

Feedzai is a financial crime prevention company, based in Portugal and with a New York base listed here, that uses machine learning to detect and prevent fraud, money laundering and payment risk for banks and payment firms. Customers include large global banks and processors, who pay subscriptions. Founded in 2011, it became a unicorn in 2021 and has raised about $352 million. It is a B2B fintech brand, with a high profile in financial crime circles.

wiki.title: Feedzai
wiki.text: Feedzai is a data science company that develops real-time machine learning tools to identify fraudulent payment transactions and minimize risk in the financial services, retail, and e-commerce industries. The company has been classified as a unicorn startup since March 2021, after a Series D funding round pushed its value above $1 billion.

about: Ivanti is a South Jordan, Utah IT software company that sells IT service management, endpoint management, security, and unified endpoint tools, formed by a merger of LANDESK, Heat Software and Wavelink. It serves large organisations globally and is owned by Clearlake Capital. It has faced criticism for security vulnerabilities in its VPN products. Funding recorded is about $350 million. It is a B2B software brand known mainly by IT teams.

wiki.title: Ivanti
wiki.text: Ivanti is an IT software company headquartered in South Jordan, Utah, United States. It produces software for IT Security, IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Asset Management (ITAM), Unified Endpoint Management (UEM), Identity Management, Patch Management and supply chain management. It was formed in January 2017 with the merger of LANDESK and HEAT Software, and later acquired Cherwell Software. The company became more widely known after security incidents related to the VPN hardware it sells.

about: Juniper Square is a San Francisco software company providing fund administration, investor relations, accounting and marketing platform for private markets, in particular real estate and alternative asset managers. Customers are general partners of funds, and it connects them with limited partners. Founded in 2014, it was valued at 1.1 billion dollars in 2021 and has raised about $371 million including a 2025 round. It is a B2B software brand with little public awareness.

Piano is a digital experience software company, with Amsterdam listed here as headquarters and offices in New York, providing analytics, audience data, subscription and personalization tools for publishers and brands. Formed from Piano Media (paywall provider) and merged with Cxense, it serves news organisations and enterprises such as media groups. Total funding is about $330 million. It is a B2B software brand with no consumer awareness, though its paywalls are widely seen on news sites.
cb_desc: Piano helps organizations understand and influence...

wiki.title: Piano
wiki.text: A piano is a keyboard instrument that produces sound when its keys are pressed, activating an action mechanism where hammers strike strings. Modern pianos have a row of 88 black and white keys—with the exception of the Bosendörfer and Stuart & Sons pianos—and tuned to a chromatic scale in equal temperament. A musician who specializes in piano is called a pianist.

wiki.title: Piano (company)
wiki.what: Film production and distribution company based in Mexico City
wiki.text: Piano is an independent film production and distribution company based in Mexico City, started in 2011 by Julio Chavezmontes and Sebastián Hofmann as a platform for innovative filmmakers. It specializes in film production, finance, distribution, and international coproductions.

about: Webflow is a San Francisco visual web design platform, offering a no-code builder, CMS and hosting that lets designers and marketers create and publish professional websites. Customers range from freelancers to large enterprises, paying subscriptions. Founded in 2013, it was valued at 4 billion dollars in 2021 and has raised about $335 million. It is a B2B and prosumer software brand with strong recognition in the design community, and it markets widely online.

wiki.title: Webflow
wiki.text: Webflow, Inc. is an American company, based in San Francisco, that provides software as a service for website building and hosting. Their online visual editor platform allows users to design, build, and launch websites. According to W3Techs, in 2025, Webflow is used by 1.2% of the top 10 million websites. Among Y Combinator companies in the 2024 and 2025 batches, 10.2% used Webflow for their homepage, behind Framer at 13.7%, after leading in every earlier batch block.
